trust_decision.summary: Which certificate name the client accepts: the unicode hostname passed to TLSStream.wrap() is handed as a str to stdlib SSLContext.wrap_bio(), which IDNA-2003-encodes it (faß.de -> fass.de), so the peer certificate is matched against a different name than the one the IDNA-2008 resolver (getaddrinfo) connected to.

landing_point.why: The summary names TLSStream and host name encoding; wrap() is the only place in src that calls ssl wrap_bio with server_hostname.

fix_sites.entry_point: anyio.getaddrinfo() (refactor only: extracted into idna2008_resolve, behaviour unchanged)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/anyio/_core/_sockets.py:646-655 is changed by the fix but is only a refactor; it was already IDNA 2008 at the pinned commit, so it is not a separate vulnerable site

O3_reason_to_dismiss: There is no route to dismiss. The only plausible partial fix is to patch the stdlib-SSLContext branch at src/anyio/streams/tls.py:147-149 and argue that the custom-SSLContext to_thread branch at src/anyio/streams/tls.py:150-158 is 'external implementations, their responsibility'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: ASCII host names and IP literals must still pass through unchanged: connect_tcp passes str(remote_host) (which may be an IPv4/IPv6 address) as the hostname, and a fix that always runs idna.encode() would reject IP literals and non-LDH ASCII names. Server-side wrap with hostname=None must also keep working.

O6_input_shapes: non-ASCII str hostname (IDNA 2008 differs from 2003, e.g. ß)
ASCII str hostname / IP literal (passed through as ascii bytes)
stdlib ssl.SSLContext branch and subclass/foreign SSLContext branch via to_thread (src/anyio/streams/tls.py:146-158)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: TLSConnectable could pre-normalise and cache self.hostname (e.g. via str.encode('idna')) at __init__, a second encoding site before wrap()
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: TLSConnectable already does eager setup in __init__ (default ssl_context creation, src/anyio/streams/tls.py:401-410); a maintainer could plausibly normalise the hostname there too. It is still a WHERE-type sibling.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: as_connectable deriving tls_hostname through a stdlib 'idna' codec round-trip
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It already derives tls_hostname from connectable.host; a maintainer could add normalisation there. Weak, and it falls together with the main fix.

O9_family: TLS certificate host name verification / IDNA encoding differential (CWE-295, CWE-297)

O10_build.toolchain: pip/hatch-style pyproject (requires-python >= 3.10), runtime dep idna >= 2.8, test dep trustme
O10_build.project_tests: tests/streams/test_tls.py (trustme CA fixtures with memory-stream TLS, fully offline); tests/test_sockets.py (the test_getaddrinfo IDNA test at tests/test_sockets.py:2500-2505 is marked network)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Call idna.encode(hostname, uts46=True) in wrap() for the stdlib branch only, or for every hostname (which breaks IP literals).

out_of_scope_notes: Only src/anyio/streams/tls.py and src/anyio/_core/_sockets.py import ssl. The backends (src/anyio/_backends/_asyncio.py, _trio.py) have no TLS path of their own, so there is no second implementation.
